name: Status Effects
pages: {b}Status effects{/} are temporary effects that can be given to players or other mobs by various means.{pb}Such means include {b}consumables{/} ({i}potions{/} or certain food items) and {i}tipped arrows{/}. Some {b}mobs{/} can also inflict status effects, such as {!}elder guardians{/}, {!}witches{/}, {!}pillager captains{/}, etc.
